scene: The steaming cart vendor offers glowing lotus dumplings.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone terrace ledge. On the left stands a mossy stone shrine holding a lit lamp. The player, in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat, stands in the centre facing a friendly vendor behind a yellow snack cart with steaming bamboo trays. On the far right rises an arched red bridge.
shown: A stacked bamboo steamer on the yellow cart at centre releasing blue steam
A small carved mossy stone shrine with an oil lamp on the left
A red wooden arched footbridge leading away on the far right

variants.scene: A friendly vendor lifts bamboo lids as blue steam curls into the mountain air.
Warm steam swirls from the cart while you hum {tune} beside the cliffside.
Paper lanterns glow softly along the stone terrace by the cheerful dumpling cart.
